name: Soludos Coco Espadrille Slides by Soludos in Blue Size: 8, Flats at Anthropologie
description: Colorful pom poms and tassels bring a bohemian-inspired flair to these espadrille slides.About SoludosNoting a lack of comfort and simplicity in chic summer footwear, Nick Brown filled the gap with Soludos. Combining " salud," the clink of a glass, and " sol," the sun, Soludos makes summer even more fun, with colorful styles in easy-to-wear silhouettes that go anywhere you please.
